usedFor: Webinargeek holds webinar registrations and viewing, and Hastewire rewrites text through “Humanize Text”, for example after “New Registration”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Registration” in Webinargeek, then “Humanize Text” in Hastewire
bestTemplate.why: The action makes text sound natural, so a registration can feed a message that reads less stiff.

watchOut: Webinargeek triggers such as “New Registration” are polling, so “Humanize Text” runs after a scheduled check.
